articles.title: Tennis Levels the Playing Field: Equal Prize Money at Top Events
articles.summary: From next year, women and men will earn equal prize money at all combined WTA 1,000 tennis events. The Italian, Canadian and Cincinnati Opens are joining in. The WTA calls it a major milestone for fairness.

articles.title: Senegal Hosts Africa's First Olympics — and a Teen Designed the Mascot
articles.summary: The 2026 Youth Olympic Games in Senegal will be the first Olympics ever held in Africa. About 2,700 athletes under 18 will compete, and the mascot — Ayo the Lion — was designed by a 16-year-old Senegalese student.

articles.title: Inside the Pokémon World Championships: 50,000 Fans, One Blinking Motorcycle
articles.summary: 50,000 fans packed San Francisco for the Pokémon World Championships. Kid Reporter Adam met a junior champion from Malaysia and saw life-size motorcycle Pokémon—one even blinked at him.
